confidence_notes: FX is the RBA USD per AUD rate of 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026, found through a web search of RBA pages. Beer, coffee, and restaurant meal anchors come from Numbeo-based figures (Expatica snapshot dated June 2026, plus Numbeo's own undated Lisbon page): about €3.1 for a 0.5 L beer, €2.4–2.7 for a cappuccino, €13.5–15 for an inexpensive meal, and €52–55 for a three-course meal for two. I converted EUR to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.16 USD/EUR, which I did not look up. The cocktail anchor uses search results saying about €8–12 in bars, and the wine anchor uses €3–7 per glass in restaurants and bars. Both are rough and vary by venue. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Lisbon, not from live listings, and are the least certain. Lisbon has strong tourism demand, and July is peak season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lisbon is priced between Southern European peers such as Porto and Madrid, and it is cheaper than Western European capitals. Its accommodation is high for the region because of strong tourist demand.
